summary.caption: A 2.39:1 anamorphic widescreen key frame from an epic fantasy film: a boundless floating-island world at first light, photographed on a 24mm wide-angle lens from a low cliff-top vantage, deep focus f/16 so foreground rock, midground citadel and distant peaks all stay crisp. Composition follows the golden ratio: the luminous world-tree and its white marble citadel occupy the right third, while the left half opens into a sea of clouds and generous negative space that carries the eye. The sun sits behind and to the left of the citadel, backlighting the entire scene: volumetric god rays fan through gaps in the cloud, rim light traces every spire and leaf, and the near cliff stays a dark high-contrast silhouette. Three depth planes separated by atmospheric haze rather than blur: dark warm-toned foreground, cool teal midground, pale violet-blue distant mountain ranges fading into a horizon-high cloud sea. Teal-and-gold cinematic grading, restrained saturation, fine film grain, subtle vignette, immense scale conveyed by tiny human figures and tiny dragons. No text, no watermark, no logos.

items.label: object
items.caption: Near foreground: a dark, richly textured cliff ledge in near-silhouette, its top edge rim-lit by the low sun. Two minuscule cloaked travelers stand at the very edge beside a worn stone waymark, dwarfed by the landscape; they are the scale anchor and the darkest value in the frame. Warm brown rock, crisp detail, strong diagonal leading line toward the right.

items.label: object
items.caption: The visual hero at the right third: a gigantic ancient world-tree with luminous turquoise foliage, its massive roots wrapping a terraced white-marble citadel of slender spires, glowing rune bridges and hanging waterfalls that dissolve into cloud. Strongly backlit with a bright rim light on every edge, tall vertical silhouette rising above the cloud sea, intricate but uncluttered architectural detail.

items.label: object
items.caption: Mid-to-far left: a cluster of small floating islands with ruined towers, long thin waterfalls falling from their undersides into the cloud sea, low contrast and cool blue aerial perspective, deliberately kept small to preserve negative space.

items.label: object
items.caption: Far right edge: a distant floating island with a pale waterfall and layered snow peaks behind it, almost lost in violet-blue haze, balancing the frame without competing with the hero.

items.label: object
items.caption: Three tiny long-winged dragons circling high above the canopy, backlit silhouettes with a warm edge glow, deliberately very small to emphasize the monumental scale of the tree.

items.label: object
items.caption: The low sun just above the cloud horizon, partially veiled, casting long volumetric god rays diagonally across the cloud sea toward the citadel; the brightest point of the image, soft golden bloom, no lens flare artifacts.
